answer: The ripple of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The lotus lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the cipher is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
